detail: Full summary: ROOT CAUSE: the MCP server serving this session is a long-lived process started Tue 09:00 (ps shows `npm exec twining-mcp@^2.0.0` -> /opt/homebrew/bin/twining-mcp, which readlink resolves to /Users/dave/code/twining-mcp/dist/index.js — the global npm install is a symlink into this working repo). dist/engine/decisions.js, dist/tools/record-tools.js and dist/engine/record-parser.js were all rebuilt Aug 4 12:30, AFTER that process launched. Node holds modules in memory, so the running server serves pre-rebuild code. Restarting the server (a new session) is the entire fix.
